FN-BYYXB4Q-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 203
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 203 as introduced would establish a minimum medical loss ratio for insurers of
dental benefit plans and health benefit plans. This bill could increase insurance premium tax
receipts into the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the extent to
which insurance premiums may increase to offset any loss incurred by insurers to pay rebates to
enrollees if the minimum medical loss ratio is not met.
Page 1

FN-BYYXB4Q-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 203
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2025
REVISED
Senate Bill 203 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Department of
Insurance by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to hire any additional personnel to
administer the provisions of this bill regarding the regulation of dental insurance.
